alternative_notation.dimension_formula: osp(2m|2n) with m=1: even = 2n^2 + n + 1, odd = 4n, total = 2n^2 + 5n + 1

kappa.description: Odd central nilpotent element carrier of inhomogeneous deformation parameter

K.description: Even central identity element (identified with scalar 1; excluded from PBW basis)

map_f.description: Odd linear map induced by right supercommutation with the uniform sum of all 4n odd root generators

references: Frappat et al. (2000), Dictionary on Lie Algebras and Superalgebras
